title: Phosphorus and boron enhanced N-doped carbon nanofibers for enhanced lithium ion storage
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19522-19529
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00982K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yaqi Ren, Junchen Tian, Sangwan Li, Xi Li, Xiangyuan Zhao, Xiang Wang, Pengchong Yang, Jiaming Ni, Xixi Ji, Pingping Liu
A phosphorus (P) and boron (B) enhanced N-doped carbon nanofiber material was prepared via a facile electrospinning method as a binder-free anode for lithium-ion storage application, achieving a high capacity retention of 94.8% after 500 cycles.
